connector.name: Godot MCP Runtime
connector.registryDescription: Zero-addon MCP server for Godot 4: agents edit, run, and play-test the game.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package godot-mcp-runtime. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the erodenn account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GODOT_PATH
env.description: Path to the Godot 4.x executable. Auto-detected if Godot is on PATH.

env.name: DEBUG
env.description: Enable verbose logging when set to 'true'.

env.name: GODOT_MCP_DISABLE_ELICITATION
env.description: Set to 'true' to disable run_project/run_script confirmation prompts (fail-open) for clients that cannot display elicitation, e.g. Claude Desktop. Tier 1 security hard-blocks still apply.

env.name: GODOT_MCP_STRICT
env.description: Set to 'true' to hard-reject anything that would otherwise prompt, for unattended operation. Takes precedence over GODOT_MCP_DISABLE_ELICITATION.
